paragraphs.text: Masticore is a creature type used for a species of artifact creatures , which is to be distinguished from manticores . While a manticore is a flying, ferocious, red-aligned, lion-like beast, a masticore is a non-flying, still-ferocious, metallic lion-like beast. Manticores are fleshy and flying; masticores are galvanized and grounded. Tenth Edition is the first time it appeared on a typeline as earlier sets did not use creature types for artifact creatures.
Masticores usually have a stinging, barbed tail just like a manticore, but they also tend to have lines of razor-like metal teeth. The name is based on the word masticate, meaning 'to eat'.

Six Masticores have been printed. All Masticores cause a discard in some form, all but Razormane Masticore ( Fifth Dawn ) have a removal-resisting ability, and all but Argentum Masticore ( Phyrexia: All Will Be One ) have an ability to deal damage.
Argentum Masticore ( Phyrexia: All Will Be One )
Masticores have also been depicted on Deep Analysis and on the Unhinged card Remodel .
